resources.string:
Choose WhatsApp's sticker folder so the app can read your stickers. Access is read-only, and nothing leaves your phone: this app has no internet permission.

The folder is at:
Android › media › com.whatsapp › WhatsApp › Media › WhatsApp Stickers
No stickers match. Try other words, or long-press a sticker to add tags.
No stickers found yet. Check that you chose the WhatsApp Stickers folder.

Smart search uses an AI model that runs on this phone to describe each sticker in Hebrew and English, so you can search by what it shows, like \"sad cat\" or \"כלב רוקד\". It runs only while the phone is charging and idle, and nothing leaves the phone.\n\nThis app can\'t download files, so download the model yourself and import it here. Gemma models are covered by Google\'s Gemma Terms of Use.
This phone doesn\'t have enough memory to run the model. Search by printed text and tags still works.
Not enough free space. Importing needs about %1$s.
Couldn\'t import the file. Try again.
Before using %1$s, compare this SHA-256 with the one shown for the file on its download page. Only continue if they match.
Describing stickers: %1$d of %2$d left. Runs while charging and idle.
Two optional on-device models make search smarter. Each runs only on this phone.

A small multilingual model finds stickers that mean what you typed, even with different words or in the other language: \"running late\" finds a sticker tagged \"מאחר\". It needs two files from the same download page, and works best once stickers have descriptions.
